dedupe_keys.name: environment agency waste data interrogator wastes received at and removed from permitted sites england

description: The Waste Data Interrogator is the Environment Agency's annual extract of what every permitted waste management facility in England received and sent on. All operators of regulated waste sites must report the quantities and types of waste they handle, and the agency publishes the returns to monitor waste flows and support planning. Each yearly release contains a spreadsheet of wastes received at permitted sites and one of wastes removed from them, with site name, permit number, facility type (landfill, transfer station, treatment, incinerator, metal recycling and others), location and planning region, European Waste Catalogue code, origin or destination and tonnage, plus summary tables for England and the former planning regions in OpenDocument format. Yearly releases are free to download as zipped files from the Environment Agency's data service. Caveats: the data are operator returns that the agency checks only partly, exempt sites and waste handled outside the permitting regime are missing, the licence field on some yearly records is blank so terms should be confirmed, and the older Microsoft Access version is no longer produced. Simulation uses: building a facility-level network of waste flows for capacity planning and disruption models, locating treatment and landfill sites exposed to floods, and estimating how waste would reroute if a site closed. Related records: the Environment Agency historic landfill sites (data-ea-historic-landfill-sites) and Defra's ENV18 local authority collected waste statistics (data-defra-env18-local-authority-collected-waste).
